# Owner & Resident Resources.
Everything you need to manage your account, submit forms, and stay connected with your community, all in one place.

## Paying your assessments
Owners can pay through their bank's online bill pay, which is usually free. Make the payment to your association's name and include your building address and unit number in the memo. Mail checks to CenterPoint Association Management, 5107 N Western Ave, Suite 1S, Chicago, IL 60625. For online payment options or your account balance, email [service@centerpointmgmt.com](mailto:service@centerpointmgmt.com) or call [773.728.0652](tel:+17737280652).

## Free Assessment Payment Option: Bank Bill Pay.
Owners are encouraged to use their personal bank’s Bill Pay service to pay monthly assessments. This is usually the easiest way to avoid credit card or online processing fees.

Prefer to pay online instead?

Payee

“Your Association Name”

Mailing Address

5107 N. Western Avenue, Suite 1S, Chicago, IL 60625

Memo

Association 4-number address (for example “1740”) and Unit Number ###

Your bank will mail the payment directly to CenterPoint Association Management. Please allow enough mailing time so your assessment is received before the due date.

Credit card or online payment processing fees, if any, are charged directly by the payment processor and are not retained by CenterPoint Association Management.

## Frequently asked questions.
Answers to common owner and resident questions.

### How do I make a payment?
If you need portal access, contact our office at 773.728.0652 or email service@centerpointmgmt.com.

### Where can I find my association's governing documents?
Contact your property manager if you need assistance locating specific documents.

### How do I get access to the resident portal?
New residents receive portal invitations during onboarding. If you haven't received yours or need a new invitation, contact our office and we'll send one to your registered email address within one business day.

### When are board meetings held?
Board meeting schedules vary by community.

### How do I report an emergency?
For life-threatening emergencies, call 911 first. For building emergencies (flooding, fire damage, elevator entrapment), call our 24/7 emergency line at 773.728.0652. A real person will answer and dispatch help.

## Can’t find what you need?
Our management team is here to help. Reach out and we’ll get you the answers or resources you need.

## Tell us about your association.
Share a few details and we will follow up to schedule a conversation with your board. No cost, no obligation.
